name: Nissa, Worldwaker

abilities.text: +1: Target land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with trample. It's still a land.
+1: Untap up to four target Forests.
-7: Search your library for any number of basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Those lands become 4/4 Elemental creatures with trample. They're still lands.

notes: Loyalty abilities. `animate` ADDS the creature type to the land's own types (characteristics.ts:72), so "it's still a land" needs nothing extra. The -7 uses `search` rather than `search-land` because only `search` binds what it found, which the following `for-each over: 'those'` animates.

issues: -7: Search your library for any number of basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle. — expected "any number" — an unbounded, may-be-zero search — scripted search { count: 99, optional: true }; renders as "search your library for 99 basic land cards" (line score 0.68, the card's lowest) — CR 701.19a

+1 / +1 / -7 (all three loyalty abilities) — expected one loyalty ability per planeswalker per turn, across all its abilities — scripted oncePerTurn: true is set per-ability, which alone would allow both +1s in one turn; harmless only because legal.ts:243 already blocks a loyalty ability when the permanent has activated anything this turn — CR 606.3

+1: Target land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with trample. It's still a land. — expected the land keeps its land type and gains Creature — scripted animate with types:['Creature'] — verified correct: characteristics.ts types() unions animated.types with the base types, and colors() keeps the original when animated.colors is empty, so "it's still a land" needs nothing extra (notes claim confirmed) — CR 205.1b

+1: Target land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with trample. It's still a land. — expected loyalty abilities are once per turn PER PLANESWALKER (CR 606.3), not per ability — scripted each of the three abilities carries oncePerTurn: true, which is per-ability scoping — CR 606.3

(all three abilities) — expected n/a — harmless — scripted legal.ts:243 already blocks every loyalty ability once activatedThisTurn is non-empty, so oncePerTurn is redundant, not wrong in play — CR 606.3

-7: Search your library for any number of basic land cards... — expected 'any number' is unbounded — scripted search count: 99 with optional: true (exact:false, capped at Math.min(99, opts.length)); a library with 100+ basic lands would be undercounted. Renders as 'search your library for 99 basic land cards' (line score 0.68) — CR 701.19a

-7: ...Those lands become 4/4 Elemental creatures with trample. — expected every land put onto the battlefield this way is animated — scripted for-each over 'those' + animate 'that' — correct (opForEach rebinds item.affected per iteration), but the scenario only exercises ONE found land, so the multi-land path is untested — CR 701.19a
